title: eludite.git.reset input
description: Reset the current branch to a revision (the Git Repository window's Reset > Keep Changes (`mixed`), Delete Changes (`hard`, which the UI confirms), and `soft`). Moves the branch: history class for agents; `hard` loses the working tree's changes and is class dangerous. The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous for an agent when the solution's policy sets `git.history` to `prompt` (the default), refused when `deny`. `hard` is dangerous for everyone.

mode.description: `soft`: the branch only; `mixed` (default): the branch and the index; `hard`: the working tree too.
